description: Radiative lifetime of the 11.624 eV resonant Ar state before resonant re-emissions.

name: sigma_Ar_1s5_direct_nm

name: f_1Sigma

name: f_3Sigma

name: tau_S_ns

name: tau_T_ns

name: triplet_weight
description: Nominal prediction includes singlet and triplet; additive quenching suppresses each branch dynamically.
